items.title: Dynamic urban decarbonization pathways revealed in rapidly urbanizing Chinese cities
items.title_en: Dynamic urban decarbonization pathways revealed in rapidly urbanizing Chinese cities
items.title_zh: 中国快速城市化城市中揭示的动态城市脱碳路径
items.summary_en: Urban economies and their associated emissions depend on a specific urban structure and change dynamically. However, few studies have captured the co-evolution of carbon and broader urban development, or identified the governance-related factors associated with such change across different types of cities. This study addresses this gap by analysing data from 232 Chinese cities between 1999 and 2019. As a key contribution, we investigate urban types as dynamic states by applying -Means++ clustering to pooled city-year observations and identify six archetypes of urban carbon evolution, together with three typical transition pathways. We further apply a low carbon city indicator framework and develop a pooled CatBoost model selected from five candidate algorithms, using SHAP values to interpret archetype-stratified feature contributions to carbon emission predictions. Our identified pathways indicate that carbon control can be compatible with rapid economic development. Cities with similar per capita emissions can nevertheless differ in transition maturity, highlighting distinct capacities and priorities for further decarbonization. SHAP analysis shows that, in earlier industry-led phases, predicted emissions are most strongly associated with industrial-activity and energy-mix indicators; the broader predictor profiles in more mature phases suggest a shift in decarbonization priorities from sector-specific improvements towards systemic action within and across sectors. In particular, Archetype 5 low-carbon leading transition cooling-intensive megacities account for 45% of total emissions in 2019, suggesting that cross-system coordination and the translation of innovation inputs into energy-efficiency improvements and low-carbon infrastructure warrant further assessment as potential mitigation directions. This study develops an integrated framework linking dynamic urban carbon archetypes, development-stage-specific transition pathways, and differentiated policy priorities, providing a diagnostic basis for understanding heterogeneous urban decarbonization transitions.
items.summary_zh: 城市经济及其相关的排放量取决于特定的城市结构，且会动态变化。然而，目前鲜有研究捕捉到碳排放与更广泛的城市发展之间的共生演变，也未识别出不同类型城市中与这种变化相关的治理因素。 本研究通过分析1999年至2019年间中国232个城市的数据，填补了这一研究空白。作为一项关键贡献，我们通过将-Means++聚类算法应用于汇总的城市-年观测数据，将城市类型视为动态状态进行研究，并识别出六种城市碳演变原型以及三条典型的转型路径。 我们进一步应用低碳城市指标框架，并从五种候选算法中选定一个聚合CatBoost模型，利用SHAP值解释各原型在碳排放预测中特征贡献的差异。 我们识别出的路径表明，碳控制与快速经济发展可以兼顾。尽管人均排放量相似的城市，其转型成熟度仍可能存在差异，这凸显了各城市在进一步脱碳方面的不同能力和优先事项。 SHAP分析表明，在早期以工业为主导的阶段，预测排放量与工业活动和能源结构指标的相关性最强；而在更成熟的阶段，更广泛的预测因子特征表明，脱碳优先事项已从特定部门的改进转向部门内部及跨部门的系统性行动。 特别是，“原型5”类低碳领先转型型高制冷能耗特大城市占2019年总排放量的45%，这表明跨系统协调以及将创新投入转化为能效提升和低碳基础设施，值得作为潜在的减排方向进行进一步评估。 本研究构建了一个综合框架，将动态的城市碳原型、针对不同发展阶段的转型路径以及差异化的政策优先事项联系起来。

items.title: Indoor air quality at the climate-health nexus: the case for enforceable standards
items.title_en: Indoor air quality at the climate-health nexus: the case for enforceable standards
items.title_zh: 室内空气质量与气候健康的关系：制定可执行标准的必要性
items.summary_en: The COVID-19 pandemic exposed a longstanding governance gap: most people spend much of their time indoors, yet indoor air quality remains far less regulated than outdoor air. Climate change is now worsening that gap by increasing the frequency and severity of wildfire smoke and heat-driven building closures, both of which degrade air quality in homes, schools, workplaces and other occupied spaces. Poor indoor air quality is therefore no longer only a building-performance issue; it is a climate-health problem with clear implications for infection control, chronic disease, cognitive performance and equity. The case for action is strengthened by growing evidence that the costs of inaction are substantial, while the benefits of better indoor environments are measurable. This perspective piece argues that indoor air quality should be governed through enforceable, performance-based standards with statutory force, beginning in settings where exposure is unavoidable and vulnerability is high. Australia is used as an illustrative case to show how monitoring, institutional responsibility and phased implementation could be built into a practical regulatory pathway.
items.summary_zh: 新冠疫情暴露了一个长期存在的治理缺口：尽管大多数人大部分时间都在室内度过，但室内空气质量的监管却远不如室外空气严格。 气候变化正通过增加野火烟雾的频率和严重程度，以及因高温导致的建筑物关闭，进一步加剧这一差距——这两者都会导致家庭、学校、工作场所及其他有人活动的空间内的空气质量恶化。 因此，室内空气质量差已不再仅仅是建筑性能问题；它已成为一个涉及气候与健康的问题，对感染控制、慢性病、认知能力及公平性均有明确影响。越来越多的证据表明，不作为的代价巨大，而改善室内环境带来的益处则可量化，这进一步强化了采取行动的必要性。 本文认为，应通过具有法定效力、可强制执行且基于性能的标准来规范室内空气质量，并优先从暴露不可避免且脆弱性较高的场所着手。本文以澳大利亚为例，说明如何将监测、机构责任和分阶段实施纳入切实可行的监管路径。

items.title: Generative AI enables human-centered design of sustainable plant-based foods
items.title_en: Generative AI enables human-centered design of sustainable plant-based foods
items.title_zh: 生成式人工智能助力以人为本的可持续植物基食品设计
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15616v1 An: new Abstract: Dietary transitions away from animal-based meat could reduce food-related environmental burdens, but plant-based alternatives must compete on flavor, texture, and overall liking. Here we extend a generative AI framework with 469 plant-based burger recipes and use it to create six formulations across five primary ingredients: bean, chickpea, lentil, mushroom, and oat. An executive chef translates the AI-generated formulations into standardized preparation protocols and refines the ingredient quantities based on culinary expertise. The integration of generative modeling and culinary expertise defines a human-centered generative AI framework for food design. We evaluate the six burgers in a blinded sensory survey with 101 participants in an operating restaurant and quantify their land use, greenhouse gas emissions, eutrophication potential, and scarcity-weighted water use. We use Big Mac scores from a previous survey as an iconic commercial benchmark. The mushroom burger achieves mean flavor, texture, and overall liking scores similar to the Big Mac, with less than one-third of its estimated environmental impact. The other formulations reduce the estimated impact further, in several cases to near one-tenth of the Big Mac value, but receive lower liking scores. Mixed-effects models quantify associations between sensory attributes and human liking and retain predictive accuracy on independent survey data, with mean absolute errors

items.title: Seasonality defines groundwater recharge thresholds across Australia
items.title_en: Seasonality defines groundwater recharge thresholds across Australia
items.title_zh: 季节性因素决定了澳大利亚各地地下水补给的阈值
items.summary_en: Reliable prediction of groundwater recharge from rainfall is crucial to water management but is scientifically challenging. Previous studies have demonstrated that caves, mines, and tunnels provide useful ‘windows’ for observing rainfall recharge timing and thresholds (i.e. amount of rainfall in a given time period causing a change in dripping from the void ceiling). Using drip loggers at sites across the Australian continent, we find that annual median rainfall recharge thresholds (RRTs) are statistically similar across 16 sites. However, thresholds vary by season. In climates dominated by winter rainfall, recharge is highly unlikely to occur during summer and autumn, even for high volume rain events. Similarly, during drought years winter rainfall may not be sufficient to cause recharge, even for events where RRTs are met. Conversely, montane and summer-wet sites showed a more reliable recharge response to rain events above the RRT. This enhanced understanding of recharge dynamics should be considered in modeling aquifer dynamics and planning sustainable groundwater use.
items.summary_zh: 可靠地预测降雨对地下水的补给对水资源管理至关重要，但在科学上却颇具挑战性。先前研究表明，洞穴、矿井和隧道为观察降雨补给的时间点和阈值（即在给定时间段内导致空洞顶部滴水量发生变化的降雨量）提供了有用的“观察窗口”。 我们利用分布于澳大利亚大陆各地的滴水记录仪发现，16个观测点的年降雨补给阈值（RRT）在统计上具有相似性。然而，这些阈值会随季节而变化。在以冬季降雨为主的气候条件下，即使出现强降雨事件，夏季和秋季也很难发生地下水补给。 同样，在干旱年份，即使降雨量达到RRT，冬季降雨也可能不足以引发补给。相反，山区和夏季多雨的站点对超过RRT的降雨事件表现出更可靠的补给响应。在建模含水层动态及规划可持续地下水利用时，应将对补给动态的这一深入理解纳入考量。

items.summary_en: Scientists may have solved a 2.3-billion-year-old mystery about how Earth maintained enough oxygen to support life. Ancient rocks reveal that phosphorus recycling in the oceans created a self-sustaining cycle that helped keep oxygen levels high, even as the planet underwent dramatic environmental changes. The discovery challenges assumptions about Earth's early atmosphere and raises new questions about why complex life took so long to emerge.
